root_cause_label: Hallucinated Jaxley Channel API and Python Version Mismatch
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote hollow channel classes using a non-existent Jaxley Channel constructor API (missing required update_states/compute_current methods and using wrong constructor kwargs), then spent the rest of the trajectory unable to resolve a Python 3.13 vs 3.11 version mismatch in the environment.
t_err_evidence: In step 4 the agent writes Pas, MammalianSpike35, and CAD classes inheriting from Channel with constructors passing 'section_prefix', 'ion_bindings', and 'params' kwargs that are not valid in the Jaxley Channel API, and without the required 'update_states' and 'compute_current' methods. The agent also tries to call self.cell.add_channels() with a list — an API that does not exist in Jaxley.
t_commit_evidence: By step 6 all three channel classes (Pas, MammalianSpike35, CAD) have been written with the incorrect hollow skeleton implementation. The code is now functionally incomplete regardless of whether import issues are resolved — correct biophysical channel implementations are not recoverable from this skeleton without a complete rewrite.
t_surface_evidence: Step 9 is the first observable failure signal: 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named jaxley' when the agent runs python3 (version 3.13) while jaxley is installed under python3.11. This exposes the environment mismatch.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of the Jaxley Channel API: the correct base class is in jaxley.channels.channel (not jaxley.channel), the Channel constructor does not accept section_prefix/ion_bindings/params kwargs, and custom channels must implement update_states() and compute_current() methods. The agent fabricated a plausible-looking but wholly incorrect API based on generic intuition about ion channel libraries.
forewarning_evidence: Step 3 shows an 'Invalid insert_line parameter' error when the agent tries to insert code at line 14 (out of range 0-13), indicating the agent was operating on wrong assumptions about file state before the main implementation errors.
